note.question: How should a seller design a low/high professional-product line and trade-in policy when consumers are initially unsure whether their expertise will advance enough to value the high-end product?
note.overview: A monopolist commits to a product line, prices, and possibly a trade-in program while forward-looking consumers choose purchases and later upgrades after uncertain expertise advancement; the solution is explicitly leader-follower and subgame perfect.
